fullContentHtml:
ISRO Assistant, UDC, JPA, Stenographer Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has released the admit card for the post of Assistants, Upper Division Clerk (UDC), Junior Personal Assistant (JPA), and Stenographer. This recruitment was released for 242 posts. Online applying process for ISRO Assistant, UDC, JPA, Stenographer Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 July 2026 to 20 August 2026. The CBT examination is going to conducted on 21 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their ISRO Assistant, UDC, JPA, Stenographer Admit Card 2026 from the link given below

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 July 2026
  • Last Date : 20 August 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 21 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 10 September 2026

Application Fee

  • All Category Candidate : Rs. 500/-
  • After Appear CBT Exam Refund : Rs. 400/- General, OBC, EWS, Other Candidates
  • SC, ST, PWD, ESM, Female :  Full Refund After CBT Exam
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
